content_sections.heading: NBT Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 145/2026/Estt. gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download NBT notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduation in Fine Arts, Graphic Design or a related field from recognized University; experience of Art concept development/visualization; minimum 5 years of experience of Book Designing/Graphic Designing of Publicity materials; knowledge of Photoshop, InDesign, CorelDraw and other related software. Experience: Experience of Art concept development/visualization; minimum 5 years of experience of Book Designing/Graphic Designing of Publicity materials like hoarding, Bill Board, Poster, Folder/Booklet, Press/Magazine Advt. etc. Age limit: Maximum 40 years Other conditions: Knowledge of Photoshop, InDesign, CorelDraw and other related software Submission of design portfolio is a mandatory requirement

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely on contract basis through manpower agency Initially for three months, which can be extended as per requirement of the Trust

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NBT Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through the National Book Trust, India website www.nbtindia.gov.in. Submit the application by 07-12-2026. Submission of a design portfolio is a mandatory requirement.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: National Book Trust, India reserves the right not to fill up the post as advertised, if circumstances so warrant Only candidates who fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria may apply
